android.desc: Check-in anywhere. Find amazing places. Save favorites to revisit later, and see your life on a map. Swarm by Foursquare is the original check-in and travel app that turns your daily journeys into a personal location history, social map, and travel journal you’ll love using. Start building the map of your life today! 📍 Check-In Fast One-tap check-ins: Quickly log your presence at any cafe, restaurant, or landmark. Capture memories: Add photos and tag friends to remember the exact moment. Privacy first: Keep your location history private or share publicly—it’s your choice. 🔍 Discover Places & Events Local search: Find coffee shops, hidden gems, and top-rated restaurants near you. Explore events: Discover what’s happening around you and explore new activities. Verified maps: Navigate cities using Foursquare’s trusted global guides. Travel logs: Automatically turn your check-ins into a visual timeline of your trips. 📌 Bookmark & Save Custom lists: Build personalized collections like “Tokyo Trip” or “Best Pizza Spots.” Travel planner: Save favorite venues and landmarks to revisit later. 🗺️ Social Map & Check-Ins See friends' check-ins: View where your friends have checked in and become mayor. Stay connected: Keep up with your inner circle's favorite spots and recent travels. Plan meetups: Comment, react, and coordinate get-togethers when you see a recent check-in. 🏅 Badges & Milestones Earn rewards: Unlock unique badges for exploring new cities and categories. Track streaks: Keep your exploring streak alive and celebrate your milestones. Win Mayorships: Become the Mayor of your favorite spots when you visit them the most in the last 30 days. Powered by Foursquare • Every place comes from Foursquare’s verified global POI database. • Accurate locations, categories, and maps trusted by millions worldwide. • The same data that powers Uber, Apple, and Airbnb — now in your pocket. Start your check-in journey today and discover every place that shapes your world. A Note on Battery We’ve spent *years* developing the location technology that powers Foursquare Swarm, making it extremely power efficient. But, as with all apps of this type, continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life
